chunks.arabic_text: الْخَصَائِصُ: فِي الْحَدِيثِ الْأَرْبَعِمِئَةٍ قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ

translations.en: Al-Khasa'is: In the 'Four Hundred' Narration, the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said:

chunks.arabic_text: خَالِطُوا النَّاسَ بِمَا يَعْرِفُونَ وَدَعُوهُمْ مِمَّا يَنْكُرُونَ، وَلَا تَحْمِلُوهُمْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ وَعَلَيْنَا، إِنَّ أَمْرَنَا صَعْبٌ مُسْتَصْعَبٌ لَا يَحْتَمِلُهُ إِلَّا مَلَكٌ مُقَرَّبٌ أَوْ نَبِيٌّ مُرْسَلٌ أَوْ عَبْدٌ قَدْ امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قَلْبَهُ لِلْإِيمَانِ

translations.en: Interact with the people with that which they know and leave them be as to that which they do not know, and do not impose (empower) them upon yourselves and us, our affair is hard (in of itself) and deemed hard (by others) – no one can bear it except an angel brought-near or a prophet sent or a slave whose heart has been tried for faith by Allāh.

en.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises engaging with people based on their level of understanding, avoiding imposing complex matters they reject or cannot grasp. He notes that the matter of the Imams is difficult and heavy, bearable only by the elect: an angel, a prophet, or a devoted servant whose heart God has tested for faith.
en.seo_question: How should one interact with people according to Imam Ali in the Hadith of the Four Hundred?

key_terms.الْخَصَائِصُ: Al-Khasa'is (a specific collection of hadiths, often referring to the 'Four Hundred' narrations)
key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)
